notes: Governing document: the Faculty Handbook (revisions as of 10/20/17), in force on the reference date 2018-02-24 (version note). Its Chapter 3 is contractual. It names Short Term Disability, Pregnancy Disability and Family and Medical Leave among 'benefits mandated by law' that all faculty receive (3.8.2.1), long-term disability for academic-year appointments of at least 50% (3.8.2.2), tenure-clock extensions (3.4.1.1), leaves of absence and reduced-time appointments (3.7.3), and modified duties for partial leaves (3.6.3.4). It states no paid parental or maternity leave of the University's own.

The two HR charts (undated; PDF metadata July-August 2017; version_uncertain) show the timeline and pay: birth parent - pre-partum leave up to 4 weeks, post-partum 6 weeks (natural) or 8 (C-section), STD (Matrix) at 60% after a 7-day wait covered by sick/vacation, University supplement of the remaining pay; then Baby Bonding 6 weeks paid (PFL 60% plus University supplement) and 6 weeks unpaid; FMLA and CFRA up to 12 weeks each. Every component citing a chart carries version_uncertain.

Main judgment (rule gap, flagged on c5 and c7): the University supplement (pay to 100% during STD and PFL) is stated only in the HR charts. The governing handbook incorporates Staff Policy Manual sections 601, 603, 610, 615, 618, 620 and 622 for faculty benefits, which are not saved, so whether the supplement is in a governing document cannot be checked. Under the rule for governing documents cited but not saved (reader instructions §1), the charts supply it: c5 and c7 (and c8, the own sick/vacation waiting week) carry cross_reference_not_saved and are not coded summary_only. The version note likewise says to use the charts where they state University provisions that add to the handbook.

Statutory and state-programme components (c1 PDL, c2 CFRA, c3 FMLA, c4 STD/SDI, c6 PFL) rest on the handbook's 'benefits mandated by law' clause, with the charts supplying lengths and pay (V1b reading). PDL is coded at the chart's periods per the R13b Santa Clara example (6 at_least, max 12); the statute's ceiling is four months (in duration_note).

Waiting periods (R21): SDI one week (UIC 2627(b); programs.csv 1) -> c4 within c1 from week 2. PFL: the charts show a '7 Day unpaid wait period', but AB 908 removed the PFL waiting period from 2018-01-01 (programs.csv 0) -> no offset on c6.
STD (Matrix) and PFL are delivered through Matrix ('MATRIX 60% Paid (STD and PFL)'), a private administrator; payer insurance_plan (M1).

Chain, birth parent: pregnancy disability leave c1 (pre-partum up to 4 + post-partum 6 or 8; FMLA c3 alongside from its start; own sick/vac c8 in week 1; STD c4 and University supplement c5 within c1 from week 2) -> CFRA bonding c2 (12 workweeks; PFL c6 for the first 6 weeks with University supplement c7 within c2; then 6 weeks unpaid).
Chain, non-birth parent: CFRA bonding c2 (12 workweeks) with FMLA c3 concurrent; PFL c6 concurrent_with c2 for 6 weeks with University supplement c7 within c2; then 6 weeks unpaid.

Not components: sabbatical leave (3.7.1; 'will not be granted for ... respite from usual duties'), Junior Faculty Development Leave (3.7.2; for scholarship or teaching), jury-duty release (3.8.2.1), phased retirement (3.5.1.3; permanent reduction toward retirement). Disability accommodation ('will reasonably accommodate an otherwise qualified individual with a disability'; Appendix F) names no statute and is not a pregnancy accommodation.

Calendar: the handbook describes a quarter system (sabbatical accrual 'for each quarter of full-time employment, up to a maximum of three quarters per academic year'; teaching loads on the quarter system); no term length stated -> calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order. The School of Law and JST use semesters.

Cross-references not saved: Santa Clara University Staff Policy Manual sections 601, 603, 610, 615, 618, 620, 622 (benefits for all faculty, incl. STD, pregnancy disability and FML), 602, 604-609, 614 (benefits for faculty at least 50%, incl. LTD), 702-706 (miscellaneous policies); Tenure Clock Extension Form; Constitution of the School of Law; JST Statutes and Policies and Procedures (Regulationes); college/school clarifications of tenure criteria; the Matrix STD and PFL plan documents; the full California Unemployment Insurance Code SDI and PFL benefit provisions.
